school: 布尔什维克党创始人/苏俄与苏联主要缔造者/先锋队理论创立者/帝国主义与革命理论的完成者
historical_significance: 弗拉基米尔·伊里奇·乌里扬诺夫（列宁，1870-1924），俄罗斯革命家、政治家、思想家，布尔什维克党创始人、十月革命主要领导人、苏俄与苏联的主要缔造者，1917-1924年任人民委员会主席。生于辛比尔斯克，兄亚历山大因谋刺沙皇被处死（1887），此事深刻塑造其革命道路。1895年参与创立彼得堡工人阶级解放斗争协会，被捕流放西伯利亚三年。1900年流亡西欧，创办《火星报》，1902年发表《怎么办？》提出先锋队理论；1903年二大裂出布尔什维克派。1904年《进一步，退两步》阐明组织路线，1909年《唯物主义和经验批判主义》捍卫辩证唯物主义，1916年《帝国主义是资本主义的最高阶段》预言革命在'最薄弱环节'突破。1917年四月提纲把俄国从民主革命阶段直接转向社会主义革命，《国家与革命》系统阐述无产阶级专政理论，领导十月起义。执政后签署和平与土地法令，1918年以巨大领土代价签订布列斯特和约为政权赢得喘息，领导内战胜利，1921年以'退一步进两步'推行新经济政策，1922年推动成立苏联。晚年口授《给代表大会的信》（'列宁遗嘱'）警示斯大林专权与官僚化。1924年1月21日病逝。其思想体系（列宁主义）成为20世纪影响最深远的政治意识形态之一。
historical_significance_en: Vladimir Ilyich Ulyanov (Lenin, 1870-1924), Russian revolutionary, politician and theorist; founder of the Bolshevik Party, principal leader of the October Revolution, chief founder of Soviet Russia and the USSR, Chairman of the Council of People's Commissars (1917-1924). Born in Simbirsk; his brother Alexander's execution for plotting against the Tsar (1887) set his path. In 1895 he co-founded the St. Petersburg League of Struggle, was exiled to Siberia, and from 1900 edited Iskra in Western European exile, publishing 'What Is to Be Done?' (1902) with the vanguard theory; the Second Congress of 1903 produced the Bolshevik split. 'One Step Forward, Two Steps Back' (1904), 'Materialism and Empirio-criticism' (1909), and 'Imperialism, the Highest Stage of Capitalism' (1916, revolution breaking at the 'weakest link') followed. The April Theses (1917) pivoted Russia directly toward socialist revolution; 'The State and Revolution' systematized the dictatorship of the proletariat; he led the October insurrection. In power he decreed peace and land, signed Brest-Litovsk (1918) trading vast territory for breathing space, won the Civil War, launched the New Economic Policy (1921) on a 'one step back, two steps forward' logic, and drove the formation of the USSR (1922). After strokes he dictated his 'Testament' warning against Stalin's power and bureaucratization. He died on 21 January 1924. Leninism became one of the 20th century's most consequential political ideologies.

cross_references.relation_type: 革命阶段论的继承与改造
cross_references.description_zh: 列宁四月提纲与毛泽东新民主主义论合读揭示革命阶段论的完整辩证法：阶段是分析的脚手架而非行动的牢笼，何时跨越、何时重设，取决于对阶级力量对比的实时审计。
cross_references.description_en: Read together, Lenin's April Theses and Mao's On New Democracy reveal the full dialectic of revolutionary stages: stages are scaffolding for analysis, not a cage for action; when to leap and when to reset depends on a live audit of class alignment.

cross_references.relation_type: 退却型改革的同构：新经济政策与改革开放
cross_references.description_zh: 列宁1921年新经济政策与邓小平1978年改革开放是同一决策类型：以'退一步'的名义恢复市场机制，死守'制高点'，把退却包装为'进两步'的前奏。市场退却是革命体系内生的应急技术。
cross_references.description_en: Lenin's NEP (1921) and Deng's Reform and Opening (1978) are the same decision type: restore markets under the banner of retreat while holding the commanding heights, packaging retreat as the prelude of two steps forward.

cross_references.relation_type: 统一叙事的政治工程学：圣战统一与先锋队统一
cross_references.description_zh: 萨拉丁以圣战叙事统一碎片化政权，列宁以先锋队政党统一碎片化运动：都选择用一个高于所有派系的共同坐标系改写内部冲突。差异在于先锋队叙事被制度化为可复制的组织技术，使列宁式政党成为20世纪最具可移植性的政治装置。
cross_references.description_en: Saladin unified fragmented powers through the jihad narrative; Lenin through the vanguard party: both chose a common coordinate above all factions to rewrite internal conflict. The vanguard narrative's institutionalization as replicable organizational technology made the Leninist party the century's most portable political apparatus.
